# Swan Digital Solutions

> Swan Digital Solutions is a website, software and digital-growth studio in Devanahalli, Bengaluru (Karnataka, India). It builds business websites, custom business software (ERP, school management portals, web applications), AI solutions and automation, and provides digital marketing support for hotels, schools, restaurants, retailers, manufacturers and growing businesses.

- Phone: +91 83105 79306
- Email: swandigitalsolutions@gmail.com
- Location: Devanahalli, Karnataka, India

## Services

- [Website Development](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/website-development/): fast, modern business websites and ongoing maintenance.
- [Software Development](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/software-development/): custom web applications and business software.
- [School Management Software](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/school-management-software/): admissions, attendance, fees and communication.
- [ERP & Business Software](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/erp-software/): operations, inventory and reporting.
- [Hotel & Restaurant Websites](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/hotel-restaurant-websites/): menus, galleries and reservations.
- [AI Solutions & Automation](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/ai-solutions/): practical AI features and workflow automation.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/services/digital-marketing/): SEO, content and campaign support.

## Company

- [Home page](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/): services, client projects, website planner, team, internship programme and contact form.
- [Client projects](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/#work): live websites and software delivered for clients.
- [Industry Internship Programme](https://www.swandigitalsolutions.com/#internships): paid, industry-placed internships for students, with a stipend paid by Swan.
